reference_styles.title: Japanese Art Grammar Master
reference_styles.description: Curated grammar system for Japanese art direction and adaptation workflows.

reference_grammar_blocks.label: composition
reference_grammar_blocks.content: vertical narrative poster layout, dominant central hero, flattened perspective, symbolic tableau storytelling

reference_grammar_blocks.label: linework
reference_grammar_blocks.content: carved ink outlines, medium-heavy contour weight, slight irregularity, minimal shadow

reference_grammar_blocks.label: color_system
reference_grammar_blocks.content: flat mineral pigments anchored by indigo, vermilion, ochre, moss green, parchment beige

reference_grammar_blocks.label: material
reference_grammar_blocks.content: washi paper grain, subtle fiber visibility, slight pigment bleed

reference_grammar_blocks.label: motif
reference_grammar_blocks.content: folklore creatures, cloud swirls, wave patterns, mountain silhouettes, bamboo

reference_grammar_blocks.label: character
reference_grammar_blocks.content: restrained facial expression, kabuki theatrical stance, dramatic body angle

reference_grammar_blocks.label: fashion
reference_grammar_blocks.content: kimono layering, structured obi hierarchy, shimada bun and hair ornament language

reference_grammar_blocks.label: decorative
reference_grammar_blocks.content: red cartouche accents, cloud swirl framing, repeating textile and border ornaments

reference_grammar_blocks.label: adaptation
reference_grammar_blocks.content: bridge Edo grammar into manga/anime readability while preserving lineage and symbolic logic

studio_presets.title: Edo Folklore Print
studio_presets.subject_rule: central heroic or spiritual figure interacting with symbolic folklore creatures
studio_presets.composition: vertical narrative poster, flattened perspective, dominant central figure
studio_presets.linework: carved ink outline, medium-heavy weight, slight irregularity
studio_presets.color_system: indigo, vermilion, ochre, moss green, parchment beige
studio_presets.material: visible washi texture with subtle fiber grain
studio_presets.motif: folklore creature plus natural symbolic motif
studio_presets.fashion: traditional Japanese robe or period costume
studio_presets.decorative: cloud swirl framing and patterned textiles
studio_presets.negative_template: photorealism, cinematic depth blur, glossy 3D rendering, western costume, neon cyberpunk lighting, excessive gradients, soft airbrush shading, modern typography

studio_presets.title: Kabuki Actor Portrait
studio_presets.subject_rule: single dominant character in theatrical kabuki pose
studio_presets.composition: portrait-led vertical frame with dominant face and hands
studio_presets.linework: bold ink contour and minimal shadow
studio_presets.color_system: flat pigments with red, indigo, parchment, black accents
studio_presets.material: paper print feel with textile pattern emphasis
studio_presets.fashion: kabuki costume styling with graphic patterning
studio_presets.negative_template: realistic photography, soft western fashion portrait, cinematic bokeh, metallic sci-fi armor, glossy skin, painterly oil brushwork

studio_presets.title: Bijin-ga Elegant Women
studio_presets.subject_rule: elongated elegant female figure with restrained grace
studio_presets.composition: vertical portrait or half-body with balanced posture
studio_presets.linework: strong black contour with clean simplification
studio_presets.color_system: muted pigment palette with textile accents
studio_presets.material: silk and paper feel with subtle rhythm
studio_presets.decorative: ornamental pattern fields and calligraphic framing
studio_presets.negative_template: modern streetwear, glossy fashion editorial photography, hyperreal skin rendering, western hairstyle, excessive facial emotion, neon gradients, plastic textures

studio_presets.title: Yokai Creature Scene
studio_presets.subject_rule: supernatural yokai or symbolic creature as dominant subject or force
studio_presets.composition: flattened story tableau with strong silhouette staging
studio_presets.linework: bold carved outlines with graphic clarity
studio_presets.color_system: high-contrast flat pigments with mythic atmosphere
studio_presets.motif: cloud swirl, mountain, wave, spirit symbols
studio_presets.character: supernatural yokai force as dominant subject
studio_presets.fashion: optional period garments when human appears
studio_presets.negative_template: 3D monster rendering, cinematic horror realism, slime CGI, western fantasy armor, deep perspective realism, modern action poster typography

studio_presets.title: Edo Manga Hybrid
studio_presets.subject_rule: anime or manga hero built on ukiyo-e composition and symbolism
studio_presets.composition: central hero framing with preserved poster logic
studio_presets.linework: clean digital ink inheriting carved contour logic
studio_presets.color_system: saturated modern palette anchored by Edo core pigments
studio_presets.material: paper-print influence mixed with clean illustration finish
studio_presets.motif: animal spirit summons and cloud swirl graphics
studio_presets.character: manga or anime hero built on ukiyo-e grammar
studio_presets.negative_template: generic shonen screenshot, random sci-fi clutter, western superhero anatomy, 3D game render, photographic lighting, uncontrolled neon palette, empty background

preset_variants.title: Canon Core
preset_variants.positive_delta: preserve historical print grammar, avoid excessive modern stylization
preset_variants.negative_delta: anime facial exaggeration, glossy rendering, cinematic realism, modern fashion drift

preset_variants.title: Luminous Fan Appeal
preset_variants.positive_delta: enhance hero appeal and silhouette attraction while preserving Edo symbolic structure
preset_variants.negative_delta: cheap idol gloss, overexposed highlights, plastic skin, random modern glam

preset_variants.title: Luxury Mystical Editorial
preset_variants.positive_delta: premium visual hierarchy, refined ornamental elegance, mythic luxury atmosphere
preset_variants.negative_delta: cheap fantasy clutter, oversaturated anime colors, gaudy gold overload, noisy background

objective_overrides.override_text: iconic poster readability, strong focal hierarchy, clean hero silhouette
clear costume readability, front-facing design clarity, silhouette integrity
denser symbolic motifs, mythic environment storytelling, narrative object placement
high visual clarity, compact symbolic framing, eye-catching central design
premium composition balance, striking hero presentation, refined decorative rhythm

compiled_prompt_rules.title: Japanese Art Grammar Default Compiler
rules: if preset == bijin_ga_elegant_women, auto preserve hair and kimono elegance
if preset == edo_manga_hybrid, allow clean digital ink and modern readability
if objective == poster, force strong focal hierarchy
if objective == lore_scene, increase motif density
if variant == canon_core, reduce modern drift
if variant == luminous_fan_appeal, boost silhouette attraction without breaking Edo base
if variant == luxury_mystical_editorial, increase ornamental refinement and premium mood
